additional_info.subject: ID0482911-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002073] Secc is offline CRM:02681001575
additional_info.body:
Dear Jan Wojak,
Thank you for your response. We understand your question.
We have checked the charger again, and checked the logs again regarding the SECC being offline.
The log of the SECC being offline is an communication log, which is a respond to the OCPP connection being lost at that moment.
We see that in these moments the OCPP connection gets lost for 5 seconds, and after that it restores itself. In the following screenshot, you are able to see that the OCPP connection was lost.
We have monitored the charger today and don`t see this problem reoccurring.
Please monitor the charge closely for the next three days to see if the problems occurs again, and if it does, you can open a new ticket regarding this issue.
We can resolve the issue the best when this is a live error.
We hope to have informed you enough and we will hereby close this ticket.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
